description: This file defines an abstract class 'AlertService' with methods for displaying alerts and confirmation dialogs, as well as related types and enums for button types and dialog dismissal.

classes.name: AlertService
classes.description: An abstract class providing interface methods for alert dialogs and confirmation prompts.

methods.name: abstract confirm( confirm
methods.description: Abstract method to show a confirmation dialog with customizable text and buttons. Returns a promise resolving to a boolean indicating user's choice.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Abstract method to display an alert dialog with specified text and optional title and close button label.

methods.name: blockingDialog
methods.description: Abstract method to show a blocking dialog with specified text and optional title. Returns a dismiss function or a promise resolving to it.

methods.name: showErrorAlert
methods.description: Concrete method that displays an error alert using details from a ClientDisplayableError object.
